items.title: Raymond James (RJF) Stock Could Be A Bargain Near Fair Value
items.summary: Raymond James Financial has more than doubled shareholder returns over the past five years, yet an intrinsic value estimate based on an Excess Returns model still points to a meaningful discount to the current share price. With market multiples looking roughly in line with peers, the question is whether the stock’s strong track record already reflects most of the value on offer. items.title: Raymond James Financial (RJF) Dividend Reaffirmation Keeps Valuation Near Fair Value
items.summary: Dividend affirmation and what it means for Raymond James Financial investors Raymond James Financial (RJF) drew investor attention after its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.54 per share on August 26, 2026, reaffirming its ongoing cash return policy. The dividend is scheduled to be paid on October 15, 2026 to shareholders of record as of October 1, 2026. items.title: Interactive Brokers gets neutral rating as account growth faces valuation test
items.summary: Investing.com -- Interactive Brokers' rapid expansion in customer accounts is driving strong revenue growth, but the pace may prove difficult to sustain as its customer base gets larger, Raymond James said as it initiated coverage of the online brokerage with a Market Perform rating.

items.title: Advanced Micro Devices Shares Rise After Raymond James Upgrades Stock to Strong Buy
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) shares gained 2. 5% in pre-market trading after Raymond James upgraded the semiconductor company from Outperform to Strong Buy and lifted its price target to $641 from $565.
